## Supplemental Sex Model Tables

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-sex-baseline
#| tbl-cap: "Appendix Table A1. Sex Baseline Cox Model --- Hazard Ratios"
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

s_sb <- summary(model_sex_baseline)

coef_sb <- data.frame(
  Covariate = c(
    "Treatment (IDV vs no IDV)",
    "Sex (Male vs Female)",
    "Age",
    "Baseline CD4",
    "Karnofsky Score",
    "Prior ZDV Use",
    "CD4 Stratum"
  ),
  HR = round(exp(s_sb$coefficients[, "coef"]), 3),
  `95% CI Lower` = round(exp(s_sb$coefficients[, "coef"] - 1.96 * s_sb$coefficients[, "se(coef)"]), 3),
  `95% CI Upper` = round(exp(s_sb$coefficients[, "coef"] + 1.96 * s_sb$coefficients[, "se(coef)"]), 3),
  `p-value` = round(s_sb$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"], 4),
  check.names = FALSE
)

qtable(coef_sb, caption = NULL, align = "lcccc")
```

## Supplemental Power Analysis Tables

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-power-reliable
#| tbl-cap: "Appendix Table A4. Required Sample Sizes by Subgroup and Power Level ($\\alpha$ = 0.025)"
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# subgroups list already contains the Whole Group entry as the first element,
# so a single lapply over all entries produces the complete table.
power_rows <- lapply(subgroups, function(sg) {
  event_rate <- sg$events / sg$n
  ns <- sapply(power_vals, function(pw) {
    required_n(sg$hr, alpha, pw, event_rate)
  })
  data.frame(
    Subgroup      = sg$label,
    `Observed HR` = round(sg$hr, 3),
    `Obs. n`      = sg$n,
    `Obs. Events` = sg$events,
    `Event Rate`  = round(event_rate, 3),
    `n (80%)`     = ns[1],
    `n (85%)`     = ns[2],
    `n (90%)`     = ns[3],
    `n (95%)`     = ns[4],
    check.names   = FALSE
  )
})

power_df <- do.call(rbind, power_rows)

qtable(power_df, caption = NULL, align = "lccccccccc", row.names = FALSE)


```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-power-underpowered
#| tbl-cap: "Appendix Table A5. Required Sample Sizes for 80% Power Across Assumed Hazard Ratios for Subgroups with Unstable Estimates. Because Male, Asian/PI, and Other subgroups had too few events to produce reliable hazard ratio estimates, required sample sizes are shown across a range of plausible assumed HRs (0.5--0.9) using each subgroup's observed event rate. Required sample sizes use the Schoenfeld (1981) approximation with Bonferroni-adjusted $\\alpha = 0.025$ and equal allocation."
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Male, Asian/PI, and Other are excluded from the main subgroups list due to
# unstable HR estimates. Their n and event counts are pulled directly from the
# sex and race strata data frames produced in the main analysis.
unstable <- list(
  list(
    label      = "Sex: Male",
    n          = sex_strata_df$n[sex_strata_df$Subgroup == "Male"],
    events     = sex_strata_df$Events[sex_strata_df$Subgroup == "Male"]
  ),
  list(
    label      = "Race: Asian/PI",
    n          = race_strata_df$n[race_strata_df$Subgroup == "Asian/PI"],
    events     = race_strata_df$Events[race_strata_df$Subgroup == "Asian/PI"]
  ),
  list(
    label      = "Race: Other",
    n          = race_strata_df$n[race_strata_df$Subgroup == "Other"],
    events     = race_strata_df$Events[race_strata_df$Subgroup == "Other"]
  )
)

hr_range <- seq(0.5, 0.9, by = 0.1)

up_rows <- lapply(unstable, function(sg) {
  event_rate <- sg$events / sg$n
  data.frame(
    Subgroup                   = sg$label,
    `Assumed HR`               = hr_range,
    `Observed Event Rate`      = round(event_rate, 3),
    `Required n for 80% Power` = sapply(
      hr_range,
      function(hr) required_n(hr, alpha, 0.80, event_rate)
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
})

up_df <- do.call(rbind, up_rows)

qtable(up_df, caption = NULL, align = "lccc", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-app-power-events
#| tbl-cap: "Appendix Table A6. Required Events and Sample Sizes for 80% Power. Required events are derived from the Schoenfeld (1981) formula, $d = (z_{\\alpha/2} + z_{\\beta})^2 / (\\log(\\text{HR})^2 \\cdot p(1-p))$, with Bonferroni-adjusted $\\alpha = 0.025$, $p = 0.50$ equal allocation, and 80% power. Required sample size is obtained by dividing required events by each subgroup's observed event rate."
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# subgroups list already contains the Whole Group entry as the first element,
# so a single lapply produces the complete table including the whole-group row.
evt_rows <- lapply(subgroups, function(sg) {
  event_rate <- sg$events / sg$n
  data.frame(
    Subgroup                        = sg$label,
    `Observed HR`                   = round(sg$hr, 3),
    `Event Rate`                    = round(event_rate, 3),
    `Events Required for 80% Power` = required_events(sg$hr, alpha, 0.80),
    `Required n for 80% Power`      = required_n(sg$hr, alpha, 0.80, event_rate),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
})

evt_df <- do.call(rbind, evt_rows)

qtable(evt_df, caption = NULL, align = "lcccc", row.names = FALSE)
```
